about: Every problem planted on purpose in the synthetic manufacturing sample (fabric_backend/mill.py, seed 7). tests/test_mill.py asserts that the rows hold exactly these and that the check finds exactly these. docs/SAMPLE-MILL.md explains them.

orphans.why: two order lines for items that were deleted from the item register
a stock movement booked on the same deleted item
an operation reported on a work center that was never set up

non_unique_keys.why: a staging table that loaded one row of a supplier's price file twice, a day apart

keyless.why: an event log: work center, event, time and minutes, with no id; two work centers log at the same hour, so no column is unique

late_deliveries.rule: a delivery whose delivery_date is after the promised_date of its sales order line

not_linked_by_the_engine.why: a self-reference (a group and its sites); the name rules never link a table to itself, so the plan leaves it out. Not a data problem: every value is a customer_id.
